targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}')

SELECT round(100 * countIf(status = 'failure') / count(), 2) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}')

SELECT round(sum(cost), 4) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status = 'success' AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}')

SELECT sum(total_tokens) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}')

SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms)) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}')

SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}')

SELECT count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}')
SELECT countIf(disposition = 'open') AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, status, count() AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, sum(cost) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status = 'success' AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, 'prompt' AS series, sum(prompt_tokens) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time UNION ALL SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, 'completion' AS series, sum(completion_tokens) AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
SELECT model AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY model ORDER BY v DESC

SELECT model AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND status = 'failure' AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY model ORDER BY v DESC

SELECT timestamp, request_id, trace_id, model, user_id, status, cost, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, ttft_ms, tool_calls_count, guardrails_count, requester_ip, user_agent, error_str FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${model:raw}' = 'All' OR model = '${model:raw}') AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT tool_name AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT user_id AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}') GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT timestamp, request_id, model, user_id, tool_name, status, substring(arguments, 1, 400) AS arguments FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${tool:raw}' = 'All' OR tool_name = '${tool:raw}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, action, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') GROUP BY time, action ORDER BY time

SELECT guardrail_name AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') GROUP BY guardrail_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT entity_type AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails ARRAY JOIN entity_types AS entity_type WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT timestamp, request_id, model, user_id, guardrail_name, guardrail_mode, action, duration_ms, arrayStringConcat(entity_types, ',') AS entity_types, masked_entity_counts, status FROM security_logs.events_guardrails WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND ('${agent:raw}' = 'All' OR user_id = '${agent:raw}') AND ('${guardrail:raw}' = 'All' OR guardrail_name = '${guardrail:raw}') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT $__timeInterval(triggered_at) AS time, severity, count() AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time
SELECT rule_name AS metric, count() AS v FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) GROUP BY rule_name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT triggered_at, rule_name, severity, triggered_value, disposition, context FROM security_logs.alert_incidents WHERE $__timeFilter(triggered_at) ORDER BY triggered_at DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: model
list.definition: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT model AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended GROUP BY model) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT model AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended GROUP BY model) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.label: Модель

list.name: agent
list.definition: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT user_id AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended GROUP BY user_id) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT user_id AS v FROM security_logs.spend_logs_extended GROUP BY user_id) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.label: Агент (user_id)

list.name: tool
list.definition: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT tool_name AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT tool_name AS v FROM security_logs.events_tool_calls GROUP BY tool_name) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.label: Инструмент

list.name: guardrail
list.definition: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT guardrail_name AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails GROUP BY guardrail_name) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION ALL SELECT guardrail_name AS v FROM security_logs.events_guardrails GROUP BY guardrail_name) ORDER BY (v = 'All') DESC, v
list.label: Гардрейл
